sections.subhead: Identity, Messaging and Creative That Make Your Business Look Credible Everywhere

body.text: Teknoppy is a branding agency in Kochi, Kerala. We create your logo, colours, typography, messaging and brand guidelines, then apply them to your website, ads and social media. Branding is priced per project, with a written quote before work begins.

Branding is more than a logo. It is the set of decisions (name, colours, typography, tone of voice and imagery) that every later piece of marketing is built on. When those decisions are written down once, every web page, ad and post is faster to produce and easier to recognise.

sections.trustline: 120+ Projects Delivered · In Kochi Since 2018 · Identity, Messaging & Ad Creative

items.title: Logo & Visual Identity
items.text: Logo design for Kochi businesses that want a complete identity, not a single mark: primary and secondary logos, colour palette, typography and the usage rules that keep them consistent.

items.title: Brand Messaging & Tone of Voice
items.html: Brand messaging work defines what you say and how you say it — positioning statement, tagline options, key messages for each audience, and a tone of voice your whole team can write in.

items.title: Brand Guidelines
items.html: A practical brand guidelines document covering logo usage, colours, type, imagery and do's and don'ts, so designers, printers and social media teams all produce work that looks like the same company.

items.title: Ad Creative & Marketing Collateral
items.html: Ad creative design for Google Ads, Instagram and Facebook campaigns, plus social templates, brochures and presentation decks built on the same identity so campaigns look consistent from first impression to enquiry.

items.title: Discovery & Brand Audit
items.text: We review your current identity, competitors, and audience, and agree what the brand needs to communicate before any design work begins.

items.title: Positioning & Messaging
items.text: Positioning, key messages and tone of voice are defined first, so the visual identity has something specific to express.

items.title: Identity Design
items.text: Logo concepts, colour and typography directions are presented, refined with your feedback, and developed into a complete identity system.

items.title: Guidelines & Asset Delivery
items.text: You receive final logo files in every format you need, plus a brand guidelines document your team and vendors can follow.

items.title: Rollout Across Channels
items.text: The identity is applied to your website, social profiles, ad creative and collateral, so the new brand appears consistently everywhere at once.

sections.intro: Our branding process has five steps, from brand audit to rollout across your channels.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Branding in Kochi

items.html: Branding built by the same team that builds your website and runs your campaigns, so the identity is designed for the places it will actually be used, not just for a presentation slide.
Messaging before visuals. We settle what the brand needs to say before choosing how it looks, which keeps design decisions tied to a business reason.
Guidelines your team can actually follow — short, practical, and written for the people who will use them every day.
Creative designed to perform. Ad creative is produced alongside our Google Ads and social media teams, so it is built around how campaigns are really run.

sections.intro: This service fits businesses that are:

items.text: Launching a new business or product and need an identity before the website and marketing begin
Established, but with a logo, website and social presence that no longer look like the same company
Running ads or social campaigns with inconsistent creative that is hurting trust and performance

outro.html: If your identity is settled and you need the channels run, see Social Media Marketing, Google Ads Management or the full Digital Marketing pillar.
If the brand needs a new home online, our Web Design team builds the website on the same identity.

paragraphs.html: Branding is priced per project. One-time branding projects at Teknoppy typically fall between Rs. 25,000 and Rs. 1,00,000, depending on scope. You get a written quote before any work begins. To get a tailored estimate, Request a Quote or Book a Consultation.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Branding Agency Kochi

items.q: What does a branding project include?
items.a: A typical project covers positioning and messaging, logo and visual identity, a brand guidelines document, and final files in every format you need. Ad creative, social templates and collateral can be added to the same project.

No. The logo is one part of the identity. Branding also covers colours, typography, imagery, tone of voice and the rules for using them, so everything your business publishes looks and sounds consistent.

items.q: We already have a logo. Can you work with it?
items.a: Yes. Many projects are a refresh rather than a rebuild — we keep what is recognisable, tidy up what is inconsistent, and document the result in guidelines so it stays consistent.

items.q: Do you also design the ads and social media creative?
items.a: Yes. Ad creative for Google Ads, Instagram and Facebook, along with reusable social templates, is produced on the same identity and alongside the teams that run those campaigns.

items.q: What do we receive at the end of the project?
items.a: The final logo and identity files in print and digital formats, along with the brand guidelines document. Exact deliverables are listed in your quote before work begins.

items.q: Can you apply the new brand to our website?
items.a: Yes. Because Teknoppy designs and builds websites in-house, the new identity can be rolled out to your website, landing pages and campaigns as part of the same engagement.
